subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Executive Compensation Structures
description: A 60-second lesson on Executive Compensation Structures.

hook.text: A CEO earns $300 million while laying off thousands. The board approved it. Shareholders are furious.

buildup.text: Executive pay includes salary, bonuses, stock options, and perks. Boards set it through compensation committees.

discovery.text: Say-on-pay votes let shareholders express opinions on executive compensation, but the votes aren't binding.

twist.text: Compensation consultants benchmark CEO pay against peers, creating an upward spiral nobody can stop.

climax.text: CEO-to-worker pay ratios have ballooned from 20:1 in 1965 to over 300:1 today.

punchline.text: 300 times the worker's pay. The board approved it.

quiz.question: What is a say-on-pay vote?
options: A shareholder vote expressing opinion on executive pay
An executive voting on their own salary
A government mandate on maximum CEO pay
